sourcePathOrIdentifier: Production MU game VPS SQL Server, database MuOnline, via bm-sql RemoteOps bridge (login bloodmoon_observer)
purpose: Phase 2A.1 -- Account Identity Integrity Validation: resolve the real, unambiguous chain from MU Account to Character(s) before Account Linking or any account-based read model is implemented.
sanitizationNote: Every query returns only counts, type/constraint metadata, or boolean-style aggregates. No username, password/hash, email, or IP value was ever selected or returned in any query result. Confirmed by inspection of all 14 raw files.

queries.purpose: MEMB_INFO.memb_guid/memb___id: nullable, collation, IS_IDENTITY, seed/increment, default
memb___id total rows vs distinct count
memb___id duplicated-value count, rows involved, max multiplicity
Per-slot (GameID1-10, GameIDC) non-empty count, Character.Name match count, orphan count
Total slot-value assignments vs distinct character names across GameID1-5
Count of characters claimed by more than one account's slots
Consistent/Conflicting/Only-A/Only-B classification between Character.AccountID and AccountCharacter slot ownership

codeSearchEvidence.finding: memb_guid appears in 51 legacy PHP files. Every UPDATE MEMB_INFO statement found uses memb_guid only in a WHERE clause (never as a SET target). create_account()'s INSERT column list does not include memb_guid. Consistent with database-generated IDENTITY behavior, never application-assigned or mutated.

notes: GAME_WRITES_PERFORMED=0 -- every query is a SELECT (aggregate/metadata only); the bridge's own keyword filter independently rejects INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/etc. Two query patterns were found to fail at the remote bridge regardless of content: (1) any output column without an explicit alias, and (2) SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(...) THEN ... END) specifically (a plain CASE WHEN EXISTS works; EXISTS in a bare WHERE clause works; only the aggregate-wrapped correlated-EXISTS combination fails) -- worked around throughout by using explicit aliases and JOIN+COUNT instead of SUM+CASE+EXISTS.
